/**
 * The T028 product vocabulary guard (D-2026-10-04-plain-language-analysis-views,
 * `.agent/T028-architect-presentation.md` section 4).
 *
 * It scans what a screen actually says - every rendered text node, including
 * text a backend delivered, graphics' captions, legends and `<title>`s - and
 * every accessible label an assistive technology would read (`aria-label`,
 * `title`, `alt`, `placeholder`, `aria-description`), against the versioned
 * list in `productVocabulary.json`. Matching is on word boundaries, so `run`
 * does not match `truncate`, and a failure names the page and the phrase.
 *
 * Exclusions are only the three the decision names, applied to one element at
 * a time with `data-vocabulary-exempt="<reason>"`: an exact source-owned
 * reference value, a user-owned name, or a Lab entry. An exempt element must
 * wrap a single value - one with element children is itself a violation - so a
 * whole panel or a backend response cannot be exempted by marking its root.
 *
 * The guard is a regression aid. A person still has to judge plain meaning,
 * uncertainty and claim strength.
 */
import vocabulary from "./productVocabulary.json";

export interface VocabularyViolation {
  page: string;
  phrase: string;
  /** Where the phrase was found: `text` or the attribute name. */
  where: string;
  text: string;
}

const LABEL_ATTRIBUTES = [
  "aria-label",
  "aria-description",
  "aria-roledescription",
  "title",
  "alt",
  "placeholder",
] as const;

export const EXEMPT_ATTRIBUTE = "data-vocabulary-exempt";
/**
 * Exact source-owned reference values inside authored text, on the element
 * that renders them, separated by " | ". The scan removes exactly those values
 * from that element's text and labels and still scans the authored words
 * around them. A value must have the shape of an identifier (letters, digits,
 * `.`, `_`, `-`, joined by " / ", optionally " vN"), so prose cannot be
 * passed off as a reference.
 */
export const REFERENCE_ATTRIBUTE = "data-vocabulary-reference";
const REFERENCE_SHAPE = /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+(?: \/ [A-Za-z0-9._-]+)*(?: v\d+)?$/;
export const VOCABULARY_VERSION: number = vocabulary.version;
export const EXEMPTION_REASONS = Object.keys(vocabulary.exemptions);

interface Term {
  phrase: string;
  pattern: RegExp;
}

const TERMS: Term[] = vocabulary.terms.map((term) => ({
  phrase: term.phrase,
  pattern: new RegExp(
    `(?<![\\p{L}\\p{N}])${escape(term.phrase).replace(/ /g, "\\s+")}(?![\\p{L}\\p{N}])`,
    "caseSensitive" in term && term.caseSensitive ? "u" : "iu",
  ),
}));

const GLOSSES = vocabulary.glosses.map(
  (gloss) => new RegExp(escape(gloss.text), "giu"),
);

function escape(text: string): string {
  return text.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
}

/** The forbidden phrases one piece of text contains, after allowed glosses. */
export function forbiddenPhrases(text: string): string[] {
  let scanned = text;
  for (const gloss of GLOSSES) {
    scanned = scanned.replace(gloss, " ");
  }
  return TERMS.filter((term) => term.pattern.test(scanned)).map((term) => term.phrase);
}

function references(element: Element | null): string[] {
  const holder = element?.closest(`[${REFERENCE_ATTRIBUTE}]`) ?? null;
  const raw = holder?.getAttribute(REFERENCE_ATTRIBUTE) ?? "";
  return raw.split(" | ").filter((value) => value.length > 0 && REFERENCE_SHAPE.test(value));
}

function withoutReferences(text: string, values: string[]): string {
  let out = text;
  for (const value of values) out = out.split(value).join(" ");
  return out;
}

function exemptReason(element: Element | null): string | null {
  const exempt = element?.closest(`[${EXEMPT_ATTRIBUTE}]`) ?? null;
  return exempt === null ? null : exempt.getAttribute(EXEMPT_ATTRIBUTE);
}

/**
 * Every vocabulary violation inside `root`, labelled with `page`.
 *
 * Also returns how many text pieces were scanned, so a caller can prove the
 * scan saw a populated screen rather than an empty or loading one.
 */
export function scanProductVocabulary(
  root: HTMLElement,
  page: string,
): { violations: VocabularyViolation[]; scanned: number } {
  const violations: VocabularyViolation[] = [];
  let scanned = 0;

  for (const element of Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(`[${EXEMPT_ATTRIBUTE}]`))) {
    const reason = element.getAttribute(EXEMPT_ATTRIBUTE) ?? "";
    if (!EXEMPTION_REASONS.includes(reason)) {
      violations.push({ page, phrase: `unknown exemption "${reason}"`, where: EXEMPT_ATTRIBUTE, text: element.outerHTML.slice(0, 160) });
    } else if (element.children.length > 0) {
      violations.push({ page, phrase: "exemption wraps more than one value", where: EXEMPT_ATTRIBUTE, text: element.outerHTML.slice(0, 160) });
    }
  }

  for (const element of Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(`[${REFERENCE_ATTRIBUTE}]`))) {
    const raw = element.getAttribute(REFERENCE_ATTRIBUTE) ?? "";
    for (const value of raw.split(" | ")) {
      if (!REFERENCE_SHAPE.test(value)) {
        violations.push({ page, phrase: "a reference value is not an identifier", where: REFERENCE_ATTRIBUTE, text: value });
      }
    }
  }

  const walker = root.ownerDocument.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
  for (let node = walker.nextNode(); node !== null; node = walker.nextNode()) {
    const text = (node.textContent ?? "").trim();
    if (text.length === 0) continue;
    const parent = node.parentElement;
    if (parent !== null && ["SCRIPT", "STYLE"].includes(parent.tagName)) continue;
    if (exemptReason(parent) !== null) continue;
    scanned += 1;
    for (const phrase of forbiddenPhrases(withoutReferences(text, references(parent)))) {
      violations.push({ page, phrase, where: "text", text });
    }
  }

  const elements = [root, ...Array.from(root.querySelectorAll("*"))];
  for (const element of elements) {
    if (exemptReason(element) !== null) continue;
    for (const attribute of LABEL_ATTRIBUTES) {
      const value = element.getAttribute(attribute);
      if (value === null || value.trim().length === 0) continue;
      scanned += 1;
      for (const phrase of forbiddenPhrases(withoutReferences(value, references(element)))) {
        violations.push({ page, phrase, where: attribute, text: value });
      }
    }
  }

  return { violations, scanned };
}

/** A failure message naming each page, phrase and the text it was found in. */
export function describeViolations(violations: VocabularyViolation[]): string {
  return violations
    .map((v) => `${v.page}: "${v.phrase}" in ${v.where}: ${v.text.slice(0, 200)}`)
    .join("\n");
}

USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: one combined W1 walkthrough after all slices; independent slice review is the merge gate.
+
+## Result and contract
+
+Build one shared `ProductStatus`/`ProductLimitation` presentation map, `DigDeeper` disclosure and `HeadlineVisualCard` (names are suggestions) in `frontend/src/ui/`. Components accept semantic **already-read** state and explicit evidence, never derive currentness, outcome, amount, zero, completeness or source health. Use the mock's hierarchy: one answer headline, one small visual (timeline, comparison, status bar or causal steps), then “What this means / What to do”; show scope and limit near the headline. Empty/unknown remain visible first-class states. Accessible labels, textual graphic equivalents, native keyboard disclosure, 390 px no overflow. Exact record IDs, raw enums, rule IDs, model versions, digests and decision basis belong in a closed disclosure labelled “How this was worked out”; exact source/user-owned names in the default reading are permitted only where their identity is the subject, never as unexplained prose. Keep existing URL selectors and source links.
+
+Single vocabulary map (examples; final entries must be reviewed against each typed source, not guessed): `UNASSESSED` → “We have not checked this period”; `PENDING_REASSESSMENT` → “New readings are being checked”; `STALE`/upstream out of date → “This result may miss newer readings”; `UNKNOWN`/not configured → “We cannot judge this yet” / “This part has not been set up”; `CURRENT` → “Using the latest checked readings” **only when the read proves it**; `INCONCLUSIVE` → “We could not tell whether the change worked”; `INEFFECTIVE` → “The trial did not meet its goal”; `VERIFIED` → “The measured trial met its goal and safety limits” with scope. Reason-code families map to a cause sentence plus next useful step: missing report, incomplete period, stale source, pending computation, incompatible comparison, missing configuration, refused read. Unknown codes fall back to neutral “We cannot explain the limit from this record” plus closed technical code, never print the code in headline. Money has distinct “No current amount can be shown” and “No price recorded”; no `$0` substitution. Read refusal differs from proved empty.
+
+Extend `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` and `.json` from T028 to scan the default reading of every W1 product route, including rendered API text, SVG labels/titles, badges and accessibility attributes. Add terms for known leaked enums/reason-code shapes, “rule ID”, “model version”, internal analytics phrases and raw IDs where they are authored prose. Scope exemptions narrowly to exact source-owned reference values and disclosure content, retaining the current single-value exemption rule. Do not exempt a whole screen, card or response. Keep a fixture matrix showing one populated, one missing and one refused state per presentation family; assert the scan saw nonzero text and rejects deliberate leaked terms outside detail. Inspect the existing `Advanced`/`Disclosure` primitives before adding a new one; adapt or wrap instead of duplicating behavior.
+

+| --- | --- | --- |

+# W1-UX-01 — shared product presentation
+
+Status: implementation-ready. Branch `task/W1-UX-01` from merged W1 UI baseline. Frontend only. This slice precedes W1-UX-02–05. Read [umbrella](W1-UX-mockup-fidelity.md), owner notes named there, `frontend/mockups/v69/index.html`, screen manifest and current `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` / `.json`. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: one combined W1 walkthrough after all slices; independent slice review is the merge gate.
+
+## Result and contract
+
+Build one shared `ProductStatus`/`ProductLimitation` presentation map, `DigDeeper` disclosure and `HeadlineVisualCard` (names are suggestions) in `frontend/src/ui/`. Components accept semantic **already-read** state and explicit evidence, never derive currentness, outcome, amount, zero, completeness or source health. Use the mock's hierarchy: one answer headline, one small visual (timeline, comparison, status bar or causal steps), then “What this means / What to do”; show scope and limit near the headline. Empty/unknown remain visible first-class states. Accessible labels, textual graphic equivalents, native keyboard disclosure, 390 px no overflow. Exact record IDs, raw enums, rule IDs, model versions, digests and decision basis belong in a closed disclosure labelled “How this was worked out”; exact source/user-owned names in the default reading are permitted only where their identity is the subject, never as unexplained prose. Keep existing URL selectors and source links.
+
+Single vocabulary map (examples; final entries must be reviewed against each typed source, not guessed): `UNASSESSED` → “We have not checked this period”; `PENDING_REASSESSMENT` → “New readings are being checked”; `STALE`/upstream out of date → “This result may miss newer readings”; `UNKNOWN`/not configured → “We cannot judge this yet” / “This part has not been set up”; `CURRENT` → “Using the latest checked readings” **only when the read proves it**; `INCONCLUSIVE` → “We could not tell whether the change worked”; `INEFFECTIVE` → “The trial did not meet its goal”; `VERIFIED` → “The measured trial met its goal and safety limits” with scope. Reason-code families map to a cause sentence plus next useful step: missing report, incomplete period, stale source, pending computation, incompatible comparison, missing configuration, refused read. Unknown codes fall back to neutral “We cannot explain the limit from this record” plus closed technical code, never print the code in headline. Money has distinct “No current amount can be shown” and “No price recorded”; no `$0` substitution. Read refusal differs from proved empty.
+
+Extend `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` and `.json` from T028 to scan the default reading of every W1 product route, including rendered API text, SVG labels/titles, badges and accessibility attributes. Add terms for known leaked enums/reason-code shapes, “rule ID”, “model version”, internal analytics phrases and raw IDs where they are authored prose. Scope exemptions narrowly to exact source-owned reference values and disclosure content, retaining the current single-value exemption rule. Do not exempt a whole screen, card or response. Keep a fixture matrix showing one populated, one missing and one refused state per presentation family; assert the scan saw nonzero text and rejects deliberate leaked terms outside detail. Inspect the existing `Advanced`/`Disclosure` primitives before adding a new one; adapt or wrap instead of duplicating behavior.

+## Result and contract

Reason-code families map to a cause sentence plus next useful step: missing report, incomplete period, stale source, pending computation, incompatible comparison, missing configuration, refused read. Unknown codes fall back to neutral “We cannot explain the limit from this record” plus closed technical code, never print the code in headline. Money has distinct “No current amount can be shown” and “No price recorded”; no `$0` substitution. Read refusal differs from proved empty.

+# W1-UX-04 — Action, work, change and verification presentation
+
+Status: implementation-ready. Branch `task/W1-UX-04` after W1-UX-01 **and reviewed/merged S6-02b and S6-03**; re-inventory their actual files at merge. Frontend only; owner walkthrough deferred to combined W1. Scope: `recommendation`, `changes`, `action-overview`, `action-plan`, `action-execution`, `action-evidence`, `action-history`, `verification`, `sitework`. Use [umbrella](W1-UX-mockup-fidelity.md), v69 named screens/manifest, S6-01b/S6-02b/S6-03 packets and the S6 verification decisions.
+
+## Visible result
+
+Make each screen answer a user question: what is proposed; what work happened; what evidence was planned/received; did the measured trial meet its goal without harmful trade-offs; what remains to do. Use one Action story across Overview/Plan/Execution/Evidence/History, plus two-window comparison graphic in Verification and chronological change/effect strip in Changes. Site Work shows scoped persisted Actions and next step, with a watermarked proved-zero state only after successful bounded read. The Action root and selected historical outcome stay visible across child links and reload. Distinguish applied, completed, resolved and verified; activity never establishes effectiveness or savings. A withdrawn older VERIFIED outcome is historical with current reassessment state. Keep guardrail failure prominent in plain language with measured value, threshold and unit; unknown required evidence yields “We cannot tell yet” without hiding known failures.
+
+Initial seams `SiteRecommendation.tsx:145-203,343-416`, `SiteAction.tsx:290-367,451-580`, `SiteFoundationChange.tsx:108-182`; S6-02b Plan/Evidence/Verification and S6-03 Site Work components are merge dependencies. Put plan IDs, event IDs, source digests, rule versions, typed reason codes, slot tables and exact cutoff in `DigDeeper`, retaining exact links. Keep accepted snapshot, latest-current default, persistent historical selector and wrong-Site/refused states from source tasks. No verification verdict derived in Site Work.
+
+## Phases and proof
+
+| Phase | Deliverable | Focused proof |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| 1 | Recommendation/Action/Work/Changes headline and workflow visuals | Accepted/proposed/applied/pending/failed and proved-zero versus unknown; exact links and selected event, 1440/390 v69 comparison for six named screens. |
+| 2 | Plan/Evidence/Verification comparative visuals and disclosure; finish all nine screens | VERIFIED/INEFFECTIVE/INCONCLUSIVE, guardrail/target misses, missing slots, withdrawn historical state and different-Finding hold; 1440/390 served comparison for Plan/Evidence/Verification. |
+
+Focused UI tests per phase; final `npm.cmd test`, type check, vocabulary scan, registry checker and relevant guards. Fresh independent reviewer checks all nine screens, S6-02b's fail-closed tests and selected URL persistence before merge. No owner walkthrough until combined W1. Backend change only if Architect confirms an absent label cannot be derived from an exact read.
+
+## Architect questions
+
+Recommend “Trial outcome” rather than “Verification” as the default heading on the outcome card, while retaining the canonical Verification tab/route. Keep the exact VERIFIED state in details and preserve the contract’s interim guardrail-failure wording.

+# W1-UX-05 — Foundation, Readiness, SLD, Health and battery presentation
+
+Status: implementation-ready. Branch `task/W1-UX-05` after W1-UX-01 **and reviewed/merged S7-01b**; inspect its actual files at merge. Frontend only; owner walkthrough deferred to combined W1. Scope: `foundation`, `readiness`, `sld`, `health`, `asset`. Use [umbrella](W1-UX-mockup-fidelity.md), v69 named screens/manifest, S1-01/02/03 and S7-01b packets.
+
+## Visible result
+
+Foundation leads with what equipment and operating settings are recorded for the selected period, using a compact equipment/configuration graphic. Readiness leads with what still needs connecting or confirming and a next-step list. SLD keeps the real configured diagram but makes reporting/unknown links and legend readable before part IDs. Health leads with source contact and reported fact age in separate visual lanes; a recent receipt never implies healthy equipment or fresh facts. Battery asset detail prominently says physical condition cannot be judged when the required causal inputs are missing, lists the missing inputs and preserves accepted SOC/rating as separate facts. No warranty, replacement or remaining-life statement.
+
+Initial seams `StoredFoundationViews.tsx:183,367-426,494-675`, `FoundationBindingsPanel.tsx:158`, `ReadinessOverview.tsx:264,347-400,512-570`; S7-01b Health/asset components are merge dependencies. Move exact revision, signal/diagnostic/binding IDs and raw status basis into `DigDeeper`; retain precise selected-time, record and diagram links. Preserve `MissingClaim` for unsupported commissioning, firmware, uptime, signal strength and physical condition. No “green zero” for absent reporting. Clearly separate not registered, never received, stale contact, old facts, unavailable read and not configured battery.
+
+## Phases and proof
+
+| Phase | Deliverable | Focused proof |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| 1 | Foundation/Readiness/SLD headings, visuals, disclosures | Selected-effective version, missing bindings, unconfirmed commissioning, absent gateway facts, SLD gap tags; 1440/390 served app/mock evidence for three screens. |
+| 2 | Health/asset freshness and Unknown visuals, all five screen audit | Six S7 central cases, old facts with fresh receipt, no source, never received, wrong Site/asset/refusal, battery missing input and exact links/reload; 1440/390 `health`/`asset` comparison. |
+
+Focused tests per phase; final full `npm.cmd test`, type check, vocabulary scan, registry checker and relevant guards. Fresh independent review checks all five screens and S7-01b fail-closed assertions. No owner walkthrough until combined W1.
+
+## Architect questions
+
+Recommend “Reporting status” for source contact and “Battery condition: cannot yet be judged” for physical asset state, shown in separate cards. Confirm any later positive condition wording only if a separately reviewed physical-condition read exists.

+# W1-UX-01 — shared product presentation
+
+Status: implementation-ready. Branch `task/W1-UX-01` from merged W1 UI baseline. Frontend only. This slice precedes W1-UX-02–05. Read [umbrella](W1-UX-mockup-fidelity.md), owner notes named there, `frontend/mockups/v69/index.html`, screen manifest and current `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` / `.json`. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: one combined W1 walkthrough after all slices; independent slice review is the merge gate.
+
+## Result and contract
+
+Build one shared `ProductStatus`/`ProductLimitation` presentation map, `DigDeeper` disclosure and `HeadlineVisualCard` (names are suggestions) in `frontend/src/ui/`. Components accept semantic **already-read** state and explicit evidence, never derive currentness, outcome, amount, zero, completeness or source health. Use the mock's hierarchy: one answer headline, one small visual (timeline, comparison, status bar or causal steps), then “What this means / What to do”; show scope and limit near the headline. Empty/unknown remain visible first-class states. Accessible labels, textual graphic equivalents, native keyboard disclosure, 390 px no overflow. Exact record IDs, raw enums, rule IDs, model versions, digests and decision basis belong in a closed disclosure labelled “How this was worked out”; exact source/user-owned names in the default reading are permitted only where their identity is the subject, never as unexplained prose. Keep existing URL selectors and source links.
+
+Single vocabulary map (examples; final entries must be reviewed against each typed source, not guessed): `UNASSESSED` → “We have not checked this period”; `PENDING_REASSESSMENT` → “New readings are being checked”; `STALE`/upstream out of date → “This result may miss newer readings”; `UNKNOWN`/not configured → “We cannot judge this yet” / “This part has not been set up”; `CURRENT` → “Using the latest checked readings” **only when the read proves it**; `INCONCLUSIVE` → “We could not tell whether the change worked”; `INEFFECTIVE` → “The trial did not meet its goal”; `VERIFIED` → “The measured trial met its goal and safety limits” with scope. Reason-code families map to a cause sentence plus next useful step: missing report, incomplete period, stale source, pending computation, incompatible comparison, missing configuration, refused read. Unknown codes fall back to neutral “We cannot explain the limit from this record” plus closed technical code, never print the code in headline. Money has distinct “No current amount can be shown” and “No price recorded”; no `$0` substitution. Read refusal differs from proved empty.
+
+Extend `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` and `.json` from T028 to scan the default reading of every W1 product route, including rendered API text, SVG labels/titles, badges and accessibility attributes. Add terms for known leaked enums/reason-code shapes, “rule ID”, “model version”, internal analytics phrases and raw IDs where they are authored prose. Scope exemptions narrowly to exact source-owned reference values and disclosure content, retaining the current single-value exemption rule. Do not exempt a whole screen, card or response. Keep a fixture matrix showing one populated, one missing and one refused state per presentation family; assert the scan saw nonzero text and rejects deliberate leaked terms outside detail. Inspect the existing `Advanced`/`Disclosure` primitives before adding a new one; adapt or wrap instead of duplicating behavior.
+
+## Phases and proof
+
+| Phase | Deliverable | Focused proof |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| 1 | Reviewed semantic vocabulary table and shared status/limitation renderer; no app-wide rollout yet | Matrix tests for current/pending/stale/unknown/refused/zero, unknown code fallback, money withheld, no status promotion. |
+| 2 | Shared disclosure/card/visual tokens and scan extension; migrate one representative Overview, Evidence and Action card only | Product-vocabulary mutation tests, keyboard/focus and accessible visual text, 1440/390 served screenshots against the three v69 screens, selected URL/link retention. |
+
+Run focused tests and `npm.cmd test` from `frontend/` on final revision; type check; registry checker and `tools/check-all.ps1` relevant guards; fresh independent review of semantics, screenshots and fail-closed behavior. Record path:line anchors of every migrated call site in review packet. Do not modify backend schema or contract.
+
+## Architect questions
+
+Recommend keeping raw codes visible inside the closed disclosure for expert support and exact diagnostics, while banning them from default text and accessible labels of the collapsed card. If a code is itself the user-facing subject, require a labelled exact-reference field rather than a vocabulary exemption over prose.

Components accept semantic **already-read** state and explicit evidence, never derive currentness, outcome, amount, zero, completeness or source health. Use the mock's hierarchy: one answer headline, one small visual (timeline, comparison, status bar or causal steps), then “What this means / What to do”; show scope and limit near the headline. Empty/unknown remain visible first-class states. Accessible labels, textual graphic equivalents, native keyboard disclosure, 390 px no overflow. Exact record IDs, raw enums, rule IDs, model versions, digests and decision basis belong in a closed disclosure labelled “How this was worked out”; exact source/user-owned names in the default reading are permitted only where their identity is the subject, never as unexplained prose. Keep existing URL selectors and source links.
+
+Single vocabulary map (examples; final entries must be reviewed against each typed source, not guessed): `UNASSESSED` → “We have not checked this period”; `PENDING_REASSESSMENT` → “New readings are being checked”; `STALE`/upstream out of date → “This result may miss newer readings”; `UNKNOWN`/not configured → “We cannot judge this yet” / “This part has not been set up”; `CURRENT` → “Using the latest checked readings” **only when the read proves it**; `INCONCLUSIVE` → “We could not tell whether the change worked”; `INEFFECTIVE` → “The trial did not meet its goal”; `VERIFIED` → “The measured trial met its goal and safety limits” with scope. Reason-code families map to a cause sentence plus next useful step: missing report, incomplete period, stale source, pending computation, incompatible comparison, missing configuration, refused read. Unknown codes fall back to neutral “We cannot explain the limit from this record” plus closed technical code, never print the code in headline. Money has distinct “No current amount can be shown” and “No price recorded”; no `$0` substitution. Read refusal differs from proved empty.
+
+Extend `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` and `.json` from T028 to scan the default reading of every W1 product route, including rendered API text, SVG labels/titles, badges and accessibility attributes. Add terms for known leaked enums/reason-code shapes, “rule ID”, “model version”, internal analytics phrases and raw IDs where they are authored prose. Scope exemptions narrowly to exact source-owned reference values and disclosure content, retaining the current single-value exemption rule. Do not exempt a whole screen, card or response. Keep a fixture matrix showing one populated, one missing and one refused state per presentation family; assert the scan saw nonzero text and rejects deliberate leaked terms outside detail. Inspect the existing `Advanced`/`Disclosure` primitives before adding a new one; adapt or wrap instead of duplicating behavior.

+# W1-UX-01 — shared product presentation
+
+Status: implementation-ready. Branch `task/W1-UX-01` from merged W1 UI baseline. Frontend only. This slice precedes W1-UX-02–05. Read [umbrella](W1-UX-mockup-fidelity.md), owner notes named there, `frontend/mockups/v69/index.html`, screen manifest and current `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` / `.json`. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: one combined W1 walkthrough after all slices; independent slice review is the merge gate.
+
+## Result and contract
+
+Build one shared `ProductStatus`/`ProductLimitation` presentation map, `DigDeeper` disclosure and `HeadlineVisualCard` (names are suggestions) in `frontend/src/ui/`. Components accept semantic **already-read** state and explicit evidence, never derive currentness, outcome, amount, zero, completeness or source health. Use the mock's hierarchy: one answer headline, one small visual (timeline, comparison, status bar or causal steps), then “What this means / What to do”; show scope and limit near the headline. Empty/unknown remain visible first-class states. Accessible labels, textual graphic equivalents, native keyboard disclosure, 390 px no overflow. Exact record IDs, raw enums, rule IDs, model versions, digests and decision basis belong in a closed disclosure labelled “How this was worked out”; exact source/user-owned names in the default reading are permitted only where their identity is the subject, never as unexplained prose. Keep existing URL selectors and source links.
+
+Single vocabulary map (examples; final entries must be reviewed against each typed source, not guessed): `UNASSESSED` → “We have not checked this period”; `PENDING_REASSESSMENT` → “New readings are being checked”; `STALE`/upstream out of date → “This result may miss newer readings”; `UNKNOWN`/not configured → “We cannot judge this yet” / “This part has not been set up”; `CURRENT` → “Using the latest checked readings” **only when the read proves it**; `INCONCLUSIVE` → “We could not tell whether the change worked”; `INEFFECTIVE` → “The trial did not meet its goal”; `VERIFIED` → “The measured trial met its goal and safety limits” with scope. Reason-code families map to a cause sentence plus next useful step: missing report, incomplete period, stale source, pending computation, incompatible comparison, missing configuration, refused read. Unknown codes fall back to neutral “We cannot explain the limit from this record” plus closed technical code, never print the code in headline. Money has distinct “No current amount can be shown” and “No price recorded”; no `$0` substitution. Read refusal differs from proved empty.
+
+Extend `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` and `.json` from T028 to scan the default reading of every W1 product route, including rendered API text, SVG labels/titles, badges and accessibility attributes. Add terms for known leaked enums/reason-code shapes, “rule ID”, “model version”, internal analytics phrases and raw IDs where they are authored prose. Scope exemptions narrowly to exact source-owned reference values and disclosure content, retaining the current single-value exemption rule. Do not exempt a whole screen, card or response. Keep a fixture matrix showing one populated, one missing and one refused state per presentation family; assert the scan saw nonzero text and rejects deliberate leaked terms outside detail. Inspect the existing `Advanced`/`Disclosure` primitives before adding a new one; adapt or wrap instead of duplicating behavior.
+
+## Phases and proof
+
+| Phase | Deliverable | Focused proof |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| 1 | Reviewed semantic vocabulary table and shared status/limitation renderer; no app-wide rollout yet | Matrix tests for current/pending/stale/unknown/refused/zero, unknown code fallback, money withheld, no status promotion. |
+| 2 | Shared disclosure/card/visual tokens and scan extension; migrate one representative Overview, Evidence and Action card only | Product-vocabulary mutation tests, keyboard/focus and accessible visual text, 1440/390 served screenshots against the three v69 screens, selected URL/link retention. |
+
+Run focused tests and `npm.cmd test` from `frontend/` on final revision; type check; registry checker and `tools/check-all.ps1` relevant guards; fresh independent review of semantics, screenshots and fail-closed behavior. Record path:line anchors of every migrated call site in review packet. Do not modify backend schema or contract.
+
+## Architect questions
+
+Recommend keeping raw codes visible inside the closed disclosure for expert support and exact diagnostics, while banning them from default text and accessible labels of the collapsed card. If a code is itself the user-facing subject, require a labelled exact-reference field rather than a vocabulary exemption over prose.

+# W1-UX-01 — shared product presentation
+
+Status: implementation-ready. Branch `task/W1-UX-01` from merged W1 UI baseline. Frontend only. This slice precedes W1-UX-02–05. Read [umbrella](W1-UX-mockup-fidelity.md), owner notes named there, `frontend/mockups/v69/index.html`, screen manifest and current `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` / `.json`. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: one combined W1 walkthrough after all slices; independent slice review is the merge gate.
+
+## Result and contract
+
+Build one shared `ProductStatus`/`ProductLimitation` presentation map, `DigDeeper` disclosure and `HeadlineVisualCard` (names are suggestions) in `frontend/src/ui/`. Components accept semantic **already-read** state and explicit evidence, never derive currentness, outcome, amount, zero, completeness or source health. Use the mock's hierarchy: one answer headline, one small visual (timeline, comparison, status bar or causal steps), then “What this means / What to do”; show scope and limit near the headline. Empty/unknown remain visible first-class states. Accessible labels, textual graphic equivalents, native keyboard disclosure, 390 px no overflow. Exact record IDs, raw enums, rule IDs, model versions, digests and decision basis belong in a closed disclosure labelled “How this was worked out”; exact source/user-owned names in the default reading are permitted only where their identity is the subject, never as unexplained prose. Keep existing URL selectors and source links.
+
+Single vocabulary map (examples; final entries must be reviewed against each typed source, not guessed): `UNASSESSED` → “We have not checked this period”; `PENDING_REASSESSMENT` → “New readings are being checked”; `STALE`/upstream out of date → “This result may miss newer readings”; `UNKNOWN`/not configured → “We cannot judge this yet” / “This part has not been set up”; `CURRENT` → “Using the latest checked readings” **only when the read proves it**; `INCONCLUSIVE` → “We could not tell whether the change worked”; `INEFFECTIVE` → “The trial did not meet its goal”; `VERIFIED` → “The measured trial met its goal and safety limits” with scope. Reason-code families map to a cause sentence plus next useful step: missing report, incomplete period, stale source, pending computation, incompatible comparison, missing configuration, refused read. Unknown codes fall back to neutral “We cannot explain the limit from this record” plus closed technical code, never print the code in headline. Money has distinct “No current amount can be shown” and “No price recorded”; no `$0` substitution. Read refusal differs from proved empty.
+
+Extend `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` and `.json` from T028 to scan the default reading of every W1 product route, including rendered API text, SVG labels/titles, badges and accessibility attributes. Add terms for known leaked enums/reason-code shapes, “rule ID”, “model version”, internal analytics phrases and raw IDs where they are authored prose. Scope exemptions narrowly to exact source-owned reference values and disclosure content, retaining the current single-value exemption rule. Do not exempt a whole screen, card or response. Keep a fixture matrix showing one populated, one missing and one refused state per presentation family; assert the scan saw nonzero text and rejects deliberate leaked terms outside detail. Inspect the existing `Advanced`/`Disclosure` primitives before adding a new one; adapt or wrap instead of duplicating behavior.
+
+## Phases and proof
+
+| Phase | Deliverable | Focused proof |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| 1 | Reviewed semantic vocabulary table and shared status/limitation renderer; no app-wide rollout yet | Matrix tests for current/pending/stale/unknown/refused/zero, unknown code fallback, money withheld, no status promotion. |
+| 2 | Shared disclosure/card/visual tokens and scan extension; migrate one representative Overview, Evidence and Action card only | Product-vocabulary mutation tests, keyboard/focus and accessible visual text, 1440/390 served screenshots against the three v69 screens, selected URL/link retention. |
+
+Run focused tests and `npm.cmd test` from `frontend/` on final revision; type check; registry checker and `tools/check-all.ps1` relevant guards; fresh independent review of semantics, screenshots and fail-closed behavior. Record path:line anchors of every migrated call site in review packet. Do not modify backend schema or contract.
+
+## Architect questions
+
+Recommend keeping raw codes visible inside the closed disclosure for expert support and exact diagnostics, while banning them from default text and accessible labels of the collapsed card. If a code is itself the user-facing subject, require a labelled exact-reference field rather than a vocabulary exemption over prose.

+# W1-UX-01 — shared product presentation
+
+Status: implementation-ready. Branch `task/W1-UX-01` from merged W1 UI baseline. Frontend only. This slice precedes W1-UX-02–05. Read [umbrella](W1-UX-mockup-fidelity.md), owner notes named there, `frontend/mockups/v69/index.html`, screen manifest and current `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` / `.json`. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: one combined W1 walkthrough after all slices; independent slice review is the merge gate.
+
+## Result and contract
+
+Build one shared `ProductStatus`/`ProductLimitation` presentation map, `DigDeeper` disclosure and `HeadlineVisualCard` (names are suggestions) in `frontend/src/ui/`. Components accept semantic **already-read** state and explicit evidence, never derive currentness, outcome, amount, zero, completeness or source health. Use the mock's hierarchy: one answer headline, one small visual (timeline, comparison, status bar or causal steps), then “What this means / What to do”; show scope and limit near the headline. Empty/unknown remain visible first-class states. Accessible labels, textual graphic equivalents, native keyboard disclosure, 390 px no overflow. Exact record IDs, raw enums, rule IDs, model versions, digests and decision basis belong in a closed disclosure labelled “How this was worked out”; exact source/user-owned names in the default reading are permitted only where their identity is the subject, never as unexplained prose. Keep existing URL selectors and source links.
+
+Single vocabulary map (examples; final entries must be reviewed against each typed source, not guessed): `UNASSESSED` → “We have not checked this period”; `PENDING_REASSESSMENT` → “New readings are being checked”; `STALE`/upstream out of date → “This result may miss newer readings”; `UNKNOWN`/not configured → “We cannot judge this yet” / “This part has not been set up”; `CURRENT` → “Using the latest checked readings” **only when the read proves it**; `INCONCLUSIVE` → “We could not tell whether the change worked”; `INEFFECTIVE` → “The trial did not meet its goal”; `VERIFIED` → “The measured trial met its goal and safety limits” with scope. Reason-code families map to a cause sentence plus next useful step: missing report, incomplete period, stale source, pending computation, incompatible comparison, missing configuration, refused read. Unknown codes fall back to neutral “We cannot explain the limit from this record” plus closed technical code, never print the code in headline. Money has distinct “No current amount can be shown” and “No price recorded”; no `$0` substitution. Read refusal differs from proved empty.
+
+Extend `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` and `.json` from T028 to scan the default reading of every W1 product route, including rendered API text, SVG labels/titles, badges and accessibility attributes. Add terms for known leaked enums/reason-code shapes, “rule ID”, “model version”, internal analytics phrases and raw IDs where they are authored prose. Scope exemptions narrowly to exact source-owned reference values and disclosure content, retaining the current single-value exemption rule. Do not exempt a whole screen, card or response. Keep a fixture matrix showing one populated, one missing and one refused state per presentation family; assert the scan saw nonzero text and rejects deliberate leaked terms outside detail. Inspect the existing `Advanced`/`Disclosure` primitives before adding a new one; adapt or wrap instead of duplicating behavior.
+
+## Phases and proof
+
+| Phase | Deliverable | Focused proof |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| 1 | Reviewed semantic vocabulary table and shared status/limitation renderer; no app-wide rollout yet | Matrix tests for current/pending/stale/unknown/refused/zero, unknown code fallback, money withheld, no status promotion. |
+| 2 | Shared disclosure/card/visual tokens and scan extension; migrate one representative Overview, Evidence and Action card only | Product-vocabulary mutation tests, keyboard/focus and accessible visual text, 1440/390 served screenshots against the three v69 screens, selected URL/link retention. |
+
+Run focused tests and `npm.cmd test` from `frontend/` on final revision; type check; registry checker and `tools/check-all.ps1` relevant guards; fresh independent review of semantics, screenshots and fail-closed behavior. Record path:line anchors of every migrated call site in review packet. Do not modify backend schema or contract.
+
+## Architect questions
+
+Recommend keeping raw codes visible inside the closed disclosure for expert support and exact diagnostics, while banning them from default text and accessible labels of the collapsed card. If a code is itself the user-facing subject, require a labelled exact-reference field rather than a vocabulary exemption over prose.

+# W1-UX-01 — shared product presentation
+
+Status: implementation-ready. Branch `task/W1-UX-01` from merged W1 UI baseline. Frontend only. This slice precedes W1-UX-02–05. Read [umbrella](W1-UX-mockup-fidelity.md), owner notes named there, `frontend/mockups/v69/index.html`, screen manifest and current `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` / `.json`. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: one combined W1 walkthrough after all slices; independent slice review is the merge gate.
+
+## Result and contract
+
+Build one shared `ProductStatus`/`ProductLimitation` presentation map, `DigDeeper` disclosure and `HeadlineVisualCard` (names are suggestions) in `frontend/src/ui/`. Components accept semantic **already-read** state and explicit evidence, never derive currentness, outcome, amount, zero, completeness or source health. Use the mock's hierarchy: one answer headline, one small visual (timeline, comparison, status bar or causal steps), then “What this means / What to do”; show scope and limit near the headline. Empty/unknown remain visible first-class states. Accessible labels, textual graphic equivalents, native keyboard disclosure, 390 px no overflow. Exact record IDs, raw enums, rule IDs, model versions, digests and decision basis belong in a closed disclosure labelled “How this was worked out”; exact source/user-owned names in the default reading are permitted only where their identity is the subject, never as unexplained prose. Keep existing URL selectors and source links.
+
+Single vocabulary map (examples; final entries must be reviewed against each typed source, not guessed): `UNASSESSED` → “We have not checked this period”; `PENDING_REASSESSMENT` → “New readings are being checked”; `STALE`/upstream out of date → “This result may miss newer readings”; `UNKNOWN`/not configured → “We cannot judge this yet” / “This part has not been set up”; `CURRENT` → “Using the latest checked readings” **only when the read proves it**; `INCONCLUSIVE` → “We could not tell whether the change worked”; `INEFFECTIVE` → “The trial did not meet its goal”; `VERIFIED` → “The measured trial met its goal and safety limits” with scope. Reason-code families map to a cause sentence plus next useful step: missing report, incomplete period, stale source, pending computation, incompatible comparison, missing configuration, refused read. Unknown codes fall back to neutral “We cannot explain the limit from this record” plus closed technical code, never print the code in headline. Money has distinct “No current amount can be shown” and “No price recorded”; no `$0` substitution. Read refusal differs from proved empty.
+
+Extend `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` and `.json` from T028 to scan the default reading of every W1 product route, including rendered API text, SVG labels/titles, badges and accessibility attributes. Add terms for known leaked enums/reason-code shapes, “rule ID”, “model version”, internal analytics phrases and raw IDs where they are authored prose. Scope exemptions narrowly to exact source-owned reference values and disclosure content, retaining the current single-value exemption rule. Do not exempt a whole screen, card or response. Keep a fixture matrix showing one populated, one missing and one refused state per presentation family; assert the scan saw nonzero text and rejects deliberate leaked terms outside detail. Inspect the existing `Advanced`/`Disclosure` primitives before adding a new one; adapt or wrap instead of duplicating behavior.
+
+## Phases and proof
+
+| Phase | Deliverable | Focused proof |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| 1 | Reviewed semantic vocabulary table and shared status/limitation renderer; no app-wide rollout yet | Matrix tests for current/pending/stale/unknown/refused/zero, unknown code fallback, money withheld, no status promotion. |
+| 2 | Shared disclosure/card/visual tokens and scan extension; migrate one representative Overview, Evidence and Action card only | Product-vocabulary mutation tests, keyboard/focus and accessible visual text, 1440/390 served screenshots against the three v69 screens, selected URL/link retention. |
+
+Run focused tests and `npm.cmd test` from `frontend/` on final revision; type check; registry checker and `tools/check-all.ps1` relevant guards; fresh independent review of semantics, screenshots and fail-closed behavior. Record path:line anchors of every migrated call site in review packet. Do not modify backend schema or contract.
+
+## Architect questions
+

frontend/docs/architecture/site-first-execution-plan.md:89:## Handoff beyond Site
frontend/docs/architecture/site-first-execution-plan.md:91:After S4, a **Findings index** can already list real Finding objects, but build the global root only when the Site detail and lifecycle are useful. frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp.md:1:# AssetOps production-shaped MVP architecture
frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp.md:5:## Product first
frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp.md:7:The [v6.9 interactive mock screens](../../mockups/v69/index.html) ask one question across Portfolio, Site, Performance, Findings, Evidence, Financials, Assets and Work: **what happened, what did it cost or put at risk, what should we do, and what evidence supports that answer?** AssetOps must connect physical operation to cost, revenue, reliability, maintenance burden and asset-life risk without turning missing evidence into false certainty. The Lab demonstrates the source of observations; it is not the source of product conclusions.
frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp.md:9:The initial usable journey is **Portfolio priority → Site Overview → domain Performance → Finding → financial consequence → Action → later verification**, with an evidence drawer at every claim. A period is explicit and retained through drill-down; each claim retains its own assessed period and revision. Financial cards identify currency, basis, assumptions, uncertainty and overlap. “Unknown” includes a reason. Counts, health, and verified value are never inferred from silence or an action being marked complete.
frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp.md:29:## Decisions and boundaries
frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp.md:39:### Edge gateway
frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp.md:47:### Ingestion and transport
frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp.md:53:### Central product model
frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp.md:55:Keep explicit relational entities: `Tenant/Site`, `Asset` (stable physical identity), `FoundationRevision` (valid-time, recorded-time, topology, objectives, controls), `SignalBindingRevision`, `Gateway/Source`, `IngestionBatch`, `AcceptedEvidence`, `EvidenceRejection`, `AnalyticRun/AssessmentRevision`, `Finding` + immutable `FindingRevision`, `FinancialAssumptionRevision`, `FinancialConsequenceRevision`, `Action/ActionEvent`, `VerificationPlanRevision/Outcome`. Evidence retains raw digest, original and normalized value/unit, timestamps, quality, mapping/configuration revision, and provenance. No retroactive rewrite of a past basis: backdated corrections create a new revision and re-evaluation with links to both versions.
frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp.md:61:### Simulator and real-site equivalence
frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp.md:73:### Domain seam and screen reads
frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp.md:80:| Site Overview `GET /sites/{id}/overview` | Site objective cards, bounded metrics, timeline, latest Finding/consequence/action, source freshness | Mini-grid service/dispatch; cold temperature/backup; EV sessions/availability. |
frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp.md:83:| Evidence `GET /sites/{id}/evidence`, `/evidence/{id}` | Capability matrix, accepted/raw/normalized records, source health, lineage, rejections | Role coverage required for each domain claim. |
frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp.md:86:| Actions `GET /actions`, `/actions/{id}` | Plan, events, later-window guardrails, verification outcome | Plan target and guardrails follow Finding's domain. |
frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp.md:88:These are API families, not a command to build every mock screen immediately. Site-scoped lists filter the **same** global Finding/Action objects. Routes without a supported read model stay out of navigation; supported routes with missing evidence show a reason and next acquisition step. Example claim path: generator state/power and PV/battery/load envelopes → accepted records tied to mapping/Foundation revisions → versioned dispatch interval classification → Finding revision + bounded fuel/maintenance consequence under assumption revision → Site/Portfolio projection → Finding card and evidence drawer. The drawer resolves exact IDs and original envelope bytes; it never reconstructs lineage from a card label.

+# W1-UX-01 — shared product presentation
+
+Status: implementation-ready. Branch `task/W1-UX-01` from merged W1 UI baseline. Frontend only. This slice precedes W1-UX-02–05. Read [umbrella](W1-UX-mockup-fidelity.md), owner notes named there, `frontend/mockups/v69/index.html`, screen manifest and current `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` / `.json`. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: one combined W1 walkthrough after all slices; independent slice review is the merge gate.
+
+## Result and contract
+
+Build one shared `ProductStatus`/`ProductLimitation` presentation map, `DigDeeper` disclosure and `HeadlineVisualCard` (names are suggestions) in `frontend/src/ui/`. Components accept semantic **already-read** state and explicit evidence, never derive currentness, outcome, amount, zero, completeness or source health. Use the mock's hierarchy: one answer headline, one small visual (timeline, comparison, status bar or causal steps), then “What this means / What to do”; show scope and limit near the headline. Empty/unknown remain visible first-class states. Accessible labels, textual graphic equivalents, native keyboard disclosure, 390 px no overflow. Exact record IDs, raw enums, rule IDs, model versions, digests and decision basis belong in a closed disclosure labelled “How this was worked out”; exact source/user-owned names in the default reading are permitted only where their identity is the subject, never as unexplained prose. Keep existing URL selectors and source links.
+
+Single vocabulary map (examples; final entries must be reviewed against each typed source, not guessed): `UNASSESSED` → “We have not checked this period”; `PENDING_REASSESSMENT` → “New readings are being checked”; `STALE`/upstream out of date → “This result may miss newer readings”; `UNKNOWN`/not configured → “We cannot judge this yet” / “This part has not been set up”; `CURRENT` → “Using the latest checked readings” **only when the read proves it**; `INCONCLUSIVE` → “We could not tell whether the change worked”; `INEFFECTIVE` → “The trial did not meet its goal”; `VERIFIED` → “The measured trial met its goal and safety limits” with scope. Reason-code families map to a cause sentence plus next useful step: missing report, incomplete period, stale source, pending computation, incompatible comparison, missing configuration, refused read. Unknown codes fall back to neutral “We cannot explain the limit from this record” plus closed technical code, never print the code in headline. Money has distinct “No current amount can be shown” and “No price recorded”; no `$0` substitution. Read refusal differs from proved empty.
+
+Extend `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` and `.json` from T028 to scan the default reading of every W1 product route, including rendered API text, SVG labels/titles, badges and accessibility attributes. Add terms for known leaked enums/reason-code shapes, “rule ID”, “model version”, internal analytics phrases and raw IDs where they are authored prose. Scope exemptions narrowly to exact source-owned reference values and disclosure content, retaining the current single-value exemption rule. Do not exempt a whole screen, card or response. Keep a fixture matrix showing one populated, one missing and one refused state per presentation family; assert the scan saw nonzero text and rejects deliberate leaked terms outside detail. Inspect the existing `Advanced`/`Disclosure` primitives before adding a new one; adapt or wrap instead of duplicating behavior.

+# W1-UX-01 — shared product presentation
+
+Status: implementation-ready. Branch `task/W1-UX-01` from merged W1 UI baseline. Frontend only. This slice precedes W1-UX-02–05. Read [umbrella](W1-UX-mockup-fidelity.md), owner notes named there, `frontend/mockups/v69/index.html`, screen manifest and current `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` / `.json`. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: one combined W1 walkthrough after all slices; independent slice review is the merge gate.
+
+## Result and contract
+
+Build one shared `ProductStatus`/`ProductLimitation` presentation map, `DigDeeper` disclosure and `HeadlineVisualCard` (names are suggestions) in `frontend/src/ui/`. Components accept semantic **already-read** state and explicit evidence, never derive currentness, outcome, amount, zero, completeness or source health. Use the mock's hierarchy: one answer headline, one small visual (timeline, comparison, status bar or causal steps), then “What this means / What to do”; show scope and limit near the headline. Empty/unknown remain visible first-class states. Accessible labels, textual graphic equivalents, native keyboard disclosure, 390 px no overflow. Exact record IDs, raw enums, rule IDs, model versions, digests and decision basis belong in a closed disclosure labelled “How this was worked out”; exact source/user-owned names in the default reading are permitted only where their identity is the subject, never as unexplained prose. Keep existing URL selectors and source links.
+
+Single vocabulary map (examples; final entries must be reviewed against each typed source, not guessed): `UNASSESSED` → “We have not checked this period”; `PENDING_REASSESSMENT` → “New readings are being checked”; `STALE`/upstream out of date → “This result may miss newer readings”; `UNKNOWN`/not configured → “We cannot judge this yet” / “This part has not been set up”; `CURRENT` → “Using the latest checked readings” **only when the read proves it**; `INCONCLUSIVE` → “We could not tell whether the change worked”; `INEFFECTIVE` → “The trial did not meet its goal”; `VERIFIED` → “The measured trial met its goal and safety limits” with scope. Reason-code families map to a cause sentence plus next useful step: missing report, incomplete period, stale source, pending computation, incompatible comparison, missing configuration, refused read. Unknown codes fall back to neutral “We cannot explain the limit from this record” plus closed technical code, never print the code in headline. Money has distinct “No current amount can be shown” and “No price recorded”; no `$0` substitution. Read refusal differs from proved empty.
+
+Extend `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` and `.json` from T028 to scan the default reading of every W1 product route, including rendered API text, SVG labels/titles, badges and accessibility attributes. Add terms for known leaked enums/reason-code shapes, “rule ID”, “model version”, internal analytics phrases and raw IDs where they are authored prose. Scope exemptions narrowly to exact source-owned reference values and disclosure content, retaining the current single-value exemption rule. Do not exempt a whole screen, card or response. Keep a fixture matrix showing one populated, one missing and one refused state per presentation family; assert the scan saw nonzero text and rejects deliberate leaked terms outside detail. Inspect the existing `Advanced`/`Disclosure` primitives before adding a new one; adapt or wrap instead of duplicating behavior.
+
+## Phases and proof
+
+| Phase | Deliverable | Focused proof |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| 1 | Reviewed semantic vocabulary table and shared status/limitation renderer; no app-wide rollout yet | Matrix tests for current/pending/stale/unknown/refused/zero, unknown code fallback, money withheld, no status promotion. |
+| 2 | Shared disclosure/card/visual tokens and scan extension; migrate one representative Overview, Evidence and Action card only | Product-vocabulary mutation tests, keyboard/focus and accessible visual text, 1440/390 served screenshots against the three v69 screens, selected URL/link retention. |
+
+Run focused tests and `npm.cmd test` from `frontend/` on final revision; type check; registry checker and `tools/check-all.ps1` relevant guards; fresh independent review of semantics, screenshots and fail-closed behavior. Record path:line anchors of every migrated call site in review packet. Do not modify backend schema or contract.
+
+## Architect questions
+
+Recommend keeping raw codes visible inside the closed disclosure for expert support and exact diagnostics, while banning them from default text and accessible labels of the collapsed card. If a code is itself the user-facing subject, require a labelled exact-reference field rather than a vocabulary exemption over prose.

+# W1-UX-01 — shared product presentation
+
+Status: implementation-ready. Branch `task/W1-UX-01` from merged W1 UI baseline. Frontend only. This slice precedes W1-UX-02–05. Read [umbrella](W1-UX-mockup-fidelity.md), owner notes named there, `frontend/mockups/v69/index.html`, screen manifest and current `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` / `.json`. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: one combined W1 walkthrough after all slices; independent slice review is the merge gate.
+
+## Result and contract
+
+Build one shared `ProductStatus`/`ProductLimitation` presentation map, `DigDeeper` disclosure and `HeadlineVisualCard` (names are suggestions) in `frontend/src/ui/`. Components accept semantic **already-read** state and explicit evidence, never derive currentness, outcome, amount, zero, completeness or source health. Use the mock's hierarchy: one answer headline, one small visual (timeline, comparison, status bar or causal steps), then “What this means / What to do”; show scope and limit near the headline. Empty/unknown remain visible first-class states. Accessible labels, textual graphic equivalents, native keyboard disclosure, 390 px no overflow. Exact record IDs, raw enums, rule IDs, model versions, digests and decision basis belong in a closed disclosure labelled “How this was worked out”; exact source/user-owned names in the default reading are permitted only where their identity is the subject, never as unexplained prose. Keep existing URL selectors and source links.
+
+Single vocabulary map (examples; final entries must be reviewed against each typed source, not guessed): `UNASSESSED` → “We have not checked this period”; `PENDING_REASSESSMENT` → “New readings are being checked”; `STALE`/upstream out of date → “This result may miss newer readings”; `UNKNOWN`/not configured → “We cannot judge this yet” / “This part has not been set up”; `CURRENT` → “Using the latest checked readings” **only when the read proves it**; `INCONCLUSIVE` → “We could not tell whether the change worked”; `INEFFECTIVE` → “The trial did not meet its goal”; `VERIFIED` → “The measured trial met its goal and safety limits” with scope. Reason-code families map to a cause sentence plus next useful step: missing report, incomplete period, stale source, pending computation, incompatible comparison, missing configuration, refused read. Unknown codes fall back to neutral “We cannot explain the limit from this record” plus closed technical code, never print the code in headline. Money has distinct “No current amount can be shown” and “No price recorded”; no `$0` substitution. Read refusal differs from proved empty.
+
+Extend `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` and `.json` from T028 to scan the default reading of every W1 product route, including rendered API text, SVG labels/titles, badges and accessibility attributes. Add terms for known leaked enums/reason-code shapes, “rule ID”, “model version”, internal analytics phrases and raw IDs where they are authored prose. Scope exemptions narrowly to exact source-owned reference values and disclosure content, retaining the current single-value exemption rule. Do not exempt a whole screen, card or response. Keep a fixture matrix showing one populated, one missing and one refused state per presentation family; assert the scan saw nonzero text and rejects deliberate leaked terms outside detail. Inspect the existing `Advanced`/`Disclosure` primitives before adding a new one; adapt or wrap instead of duplicating behavior.
+
+## Phases and proof
+
+| Phase | Deliverable | Focused proof |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| 1 | Reviewed semantic vocabulary table and shared status/limitation renderer; no app-wide rollout yet | Matrix tests for current/pending/stale/unknown/refused/zero, unknown code fallback, money withheld, no status promotion. |
+| 2 | Shared disclosure/card/visual tokens and scan extension; migrate one representative Overview, Evidence and Action card only | Product-vocabulary mutation tests, keyboard/focus and accessible visual text, 1440/390 served screenshots against the three v69 screens, selected URL/link retention. |
+
+Run focused tests and `npm.cmd test` from `frontend/` on final revision; type check; registry checker and `tools/check-all.ps1` relevant guards; fresh independent review of semantics, screenshots and fail-closed behavior. Record path:line anchors of every migrated call site in review packet. Do not modify backend schema or contract.
+
+## Architect questions
+
+Recommend keeping raw codes visible inside the closed disclosure for expert support and exact diagnostics, while banning them from default text and accessible labels of the collapsed card. If a code is itself the user-facing subject, require a labelled exact-reference field rather than a vocabulary exemption over prose.

Add `tools/s2_demo_walkthrough.py` for accepted/rejected Evidence and the S1 owner fixture for Foundation/Readiness/SLD. An index page/script may print this ordered URL list, but it must not mutate datasets or claim a single common lineage. Capture one supported, one limited/pending, one stale/withdrawn and one proved-zero path where their read supports them; 1440 and 390 screenshots, keyboard disclosure, exact links/reload, no cross-case numeric comparisons. Owner walks the complete W1 journey once and records acceptance; W1 completes only then.
+
+## Architect questions
+
+1. Recommend a closed inline “How this was worked out” disclosure on every default screen, with existing Analysis tab for long evidence trails. This satisfies the owner's deeper-analysis option without inventing a route or fragmenting selected state. Architect should settle whether a separate tab is mandatory for the small screens.
+2. Recommend retaining approved domain words “Finding”, “Action”, “Evidence”, “Site”, “Verification” when explained by nearby plain text. Ban implementation states and IDs from default prose, while exact user/source references remain inside detail or labelled links. Architect should approve the vocabulary exceptions before W1-UX-01 implementation.

+# W1-UX-01 — shared product presentation
+
+Status: implementation-ready. Branch `task/W1-UX-01` from merged W1 UI baseline. Frontend only. This slice precedes W1-UX-02–05. Read [umbrella](W1-UX-mockup-fidelity.md), owner notes named there, `frontend/mockups/v69/index.html`, screen manifest and current `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` / `.json`. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: one combined W1 walkthrough after all slices; independent slice review is the merge gate.
+
+## Result and contract
+
+Build one shared `ProductStatus`/`ProductLimitation` presentation map, `DigDeeper` disclosure and `HeadlineVisualCard` (names are suggestions) in `frontend/src/ui/`. Components accept semantic **already-read** state and explicit evidence, never derive currentness, outcome, amount, zero, completeness or source health. Use the mock's hierarchy: one answer headline, one small visual (timeline, comparison, status bar or causal steps), then “What this means / What to do”; show scope and limit near the headline. Empty/unknown remain visible first-class states. Accessible labels, textual graphic equivalents, native keyboard disclosure, 390 px no overflow. Exact record IDs, raw enums, rule IDs, model versions, digests and decision basis belong in a closed disclosure labelled “How this was worked out”; exact source/user-owned names in the default reading are permitted only where their identity is the subject, never as unexplained prose. Keep existing URL selectors and source links.
+
+Single vocabulary map (examples; final entries must be reviewed against each typed source, not guessed): `UNASSESSED` → “We have not checked this period”; `PENDING_REASSESSMENT` → “New readings are being checked”; `STALE`/upstream out of date → “This result may miss newer readings”; `UNKNOWN`/not configured → “We cannot judge this yet” / “This part has not been set up”; `CURRENT` → “Using the latest checked readings” **only when the read proves it**; `INCONCLUSIVE` → “We could not tell whether the change worked”; `INEFFECTIVE` → “The trial did not meet its goal”; `VERIFIED` → “The measured trial met its goal and safety limits” with scope. Reason-code families map to a cause sentence plus next useful step: missing report, incomplete period, stale source, pending computation, incompatible comparison, missing configuration, refused read. Unknown codes fall back to neutral “We cannot explain the limit from this record” plus closed technical code, never print the code in headline. Money has distinct “No current amount can be shown” and “No price recorded”; no `$0` substitution. Read refusal differs from proved empty.
+
+Extend `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` and `.json` from T028 to scan the default reading of every W1 product route, including rendered API text, SVG labels/titles, badges and accessibility attributes. Add terms for known leaked enums/reason-code shapes, “rule ID”, “model version”, internal analytics phrases and raw IDs where they are authored prose. Scope exemptions narrowly to exact source-owned reference values and disclosure content, retaining the current single-value exemption rule. Do not exempt a whole screen, card or response. Keep a fixture matrix showing one populated, one missing and one refused state per presentation family; assert the scan saw nonzero text and rejects deliberate leaked terms outside detail. Inspect the existing `Advanced`/`Disclosure` primitives before adding a new one; adapt or wrap instead of duplicating behavior.

+# W1-UX-01 — shared product presentation
+
+Status: implementation-ready. Branch `task/W1-UX-01` from merged W1 UI baseline. Frontend only. This slice precedes W1-UX-02–05. Read [umbrella](W1-UX-mockup-fidelity.md), owner notes named there, `frontend/mockups/v69/index.html`, screen manifest and current `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` / `.json`. USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: one combined W1 walkthrough after all slices; independent slice review is the merge gate.
+
+## Result and contract
+
+Build one shared `ProductStatus`/`ProductLimitation` presentation map, `DigDeeper` disclosure and `HeadlineVisualCard` (names are suggestions) in `frontend/src/ui/`. Components accept semantic **already-read** state and explicit evidence, never derive currentness, outcome, amount, zero, completeness or source health. Use the mock's hierarchy: one answer headline, one small visual (timeline, comparison, status bar or causal steps), then “What this means / What to do”; show scope and limit near the headline. Empty/unknown remain visible first-class states. Accessible labels, textual graphic equivalents, native keyboard disclosure, 390 px no overflow. Exact record IDs, raw enums, rule IDs, model versions, digests and decision basis belong in a closed disclosure labelled “How this was worked out”; exact source/user-owned names in the default reading are permitted only where their identity is the subject, never as unexplained prose. Keep existing URL selectors and source links.
+
+Single vocabulary map (examples; final entries must be reviewed against each typed source, not guessed): `UNASSESSED` → “We have not checked this period”; `PENDING_REASSESSMENT` → “New readings are being checked”; `STALE`/upstream out of date → “This result may miss newer readings”; `UNKNOWN`/not configured → “We cannot judge this yet” / “This part has not been set up”; `CURRENT` → “Using the latest checked readings” **only when the read proves it**; `INCONCLUSIVE` → “We could not tell whether the change worked”; `INEFFECTIVE` → “The trial did not meet its goal”; `VERIFIED` → “The measured trial met its goal and safety limits” with scope. Reason-code families map to a cause sentence plus next useful step: missing report, incomplete period, stale source, pending computation, incompatible comparison, missing configuration, refused read. Unknown codes fall back to neutral “We cannot explain the limit from this record” plus closed technical code, never print the code in headline. Money has distinct “No current amount can be shown” and “No price recorded”; no `$0` substitution. Read refusal differs from proved empty.
+
+Extend `frontend/src/test/productVocabulary.ts` and `.json` from T028 to scan the default reading of every W1 product route, including rendered API text, SVG labels/titles, badges and accessibility attributes. Add terms for known leaked enums/reason-code shapes, “rule ID”, “model version”, internal analytics phrases and raw IDs where they are authored prose. Scope exemptions narrowly to exact source-owned reference values and disclosure content, retaining the current single-value exemption rule. Do not exempt a whole screen, card or response. Keep a fixture matrix showing one populated, one missing and one refused state per presentation family; assert the scan saw nonzero text and rejects deliberate leaked terms outside detail. Inspect the existing `Advanced`/`Disclosure` primitives before adding a new one; adapt or wrap instead of duplicating behavior.
+
+## Phases and proof
+
+| Phase | Deliverable | Focused proof |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| 1 | Reviewed semantic vocabulary table and shared status/limitation renderer; no app-wide rollout yet | Matrix tests for current/pending/stale/unknown/refused/zero, unknown code fallback, money withheld, no status promotion. |
+| 2 | Shared disclosure/card/visual tokens and scan extension; migrate one representative Overview, Evidence and Action card only | Product-vocabulary mutation tests, keyboard/focus and accessible visual text, 1440/390 served screenshots against the three v69 screens, selected URL/link retention. |
+
+Run focused tests and `npm.cmd test` from `frontend/` on final revision; type check; registry checker and `tools/check-all.ps1` relevant guards; fresh independent review of semantics, screenshots and fail-closed behavior. Record path:line anchors of every migrated call site in review packet. Do not modify backend schema or contract.
+
+## Architect questions
+
+Recommend keeping raw codes visible inside the closed disclosure for expert support and exact diagnostics, while banning them from default text and accessible labels of the collapsed card. If a code is itself the user-facing subject, require a labelled exact-reference field rather than a vocabulary exemption over prose.

+# W1-UX-03 — Evidence, Dispatch and Analysis presentation
+
+Status: implementation-ready. Branch `task/W1-UX-03`, after reviewed/merged W1-UX-01. Frontend only. Owner walkthrough deferred to combined W1. Scope: registry IDs `evidence`, `evidence-analysis`, `dispatch`, `analysis`. Use [umbrella inventory](W1-UX-mockup-fidelity.md), v69 named screens/manifest and S2-02/S3-01/S3-02b exact-read packets.
+
+## Visible result
+
+Evidence leads with “Which readings can we rely on?” and a coverage/source timeline. Separate accepted/rejected/duplicate records, central contact and derived-analysis freshness; fresh gateway receipt cannot imply fresh source facts or current analysis. Claim-limit card leads with what selected assessment supports and a covered/missing span visual; keep missing role and selected-window bound beside it. Dispatch leads with the generator story and block classification timeline, selected block and limitation. Analysis turns accepted measurements into a short evidence → rule → bounded conclusion sequence. Existing detailed tables and direct record links remain inside the Analysis route or `DigDeeper`; no selected revision/cutoff loss. Revisit S4-05b interim source labels for plain contact/fact-age explanations without implying physical origin or equipment condition.
+
+First seams: `LedgerSiteEvidence.tsx:377-502,649-737,774-801`, `EvidenceClaimLimit.tsx:300-381,509-549,667-728`, `PerformanceDispatch.tsx:291-317,399-416,600-624`, `assessmentAnalysis.tsx:242-257`. Preserve S3-02b `Technical details` exact records, rule and versions while replacing default “claim limit” style language. Keep unsupported evidence-health grades and source status explicit `MissingClaim` states. No conclusion from a missing battery-limit report, stale analysis or refused read.
+
+## Phases and proof
+
+| Phase | Deliverable | Focused proof |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| 1 | Evidence and selected claim-limit hierarchy, source/coverage visual, disclosure | S2/S3 UI tests for accepted/rejected/duplicate/missing/stale/refused and selected ID/reload; v69 `evidence`, `evidence-analysis` screenshots at 1440/390. |
+| 2 | Dispatch/Analysis block timeline and causal story; finish vocabulary audit | Exact selected revision and source links, indeterminate/missing block, late input/pending reassessment, no raw model version by default; 1440/390 `dispatch`, `analysis` screenshots. |
+
+Focused tests per phase; final-revision full `npm.cmd test`, type check, registry checker, relevant `tools/check-all.ps1` guards; fresh independent review of four screens and app/mock difference table. No per-slice owner walkthrough. Do not change classification, evidence provenance or stale/current policy.
+
+## Architect questions
+
+Recommend “What the readings can support” as the visible section title and reserve “claim limit” for technical detail; retain the selected-period boundary directly beside the headline.

+# W1-UX-04 — Action, work, change and verification presentation
+
+Status: implementation-ready. Branch `task/W1-UX-04` after W1-UX-01 **and reviewed/merged S6-02b and S6-03**; re-inventory their actual files at merge. Frontend only; owner walkthrough deferred to combined W1. Scope: `recommendation`, `changes`, `action-overview`, `action-plan`, `action-execution`, `action-evidence`, `action-history`, `verification`, `sitework`. Use [umbrella](W1-UX-mockup-fidelity.md), v69 named screens/manifest, S6-01b/S6-02b/S6-03 packets and the S6 verification decisions.
+
+## Visible result
+
+Make each screen answer a user question: what is proposed; what work happened; what evidence was planned/received; did the measured trial meet its goal without harmful trade-offs; what remains to do. Use one Action story across Overview/Plan/Execution/Evidence/History, plus two-window comparison graphic in Verification and chronological change/effect strip in Changes. Site Work shows scoped persisted Actions and next step, with a watermarked proved-zero state only after successful bounded read. The Action root and selected historical outcome stay visible across child links and reload. Distinguish applied, completed, resolved and verified; activity never establishes effectiveness or savings. A withdrawn older VERIFIED outcome is historical with current reassessment state. Keep guardrail failure prominent in plain language with measured value, threshold and unit; unknown required evidence yields “We cannot tell yet” without hiding known failures.
+
+Initial seams `SiteRecommendation.tsx:145-203,343-416`, `SiteAction.tsx:290-367,451-580`, `SiteFoundationChange.tsx:108-182`; S6-02b Plan/Evidence/Verification and S6-03 Site Work components are merge dependencies. Put plan IDs, event IDs, source digests, rule versions, typed reason codes, slot tables and exact cutoff in `DigDeeper`, retaining exact links. Keep accepted snapshot, latest-current default, persistent historical selector and wrong-Site/refused states from source tasks. No verification verdict derived in Site Work.
+
+## Phases and proof
+
+| Phase | Deliverable | Focused proof |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| 1 | Recommendation/Action/Work/Changes headline and workflow visuals | Accepted/proposed/applied/pending/failed and proved-zero versus unknown; exact links and selected event, 1440/390 v69 comparison for six named screens. |
+| 2 | Plan/Evidence/Verification comparative visuals and disclosure; finish all nine screens | VERIFIED/INEFFECTIVE/INCONCLUSIVE, guardrail/target misses, missing slots, withdrawn historical state and different-Finding hold; 1440/390 served comparison for Plan/Evidence/Verification. |
+
+Focused UI tests per phase; final `npm.cmd test`, type check, vocabulary scan, registry checker and relevant guards. Fresh independent reviewer checks all nine screens, S6-02b's fail-closed tests and selected URL persistence before merge. No owner walkthrough until combined W1. Backend change only if Architect confirms an absent label cannot be derived from an exact read.
+
+## Architect questions
+
+Recommend “Trial outcome” rather than “Verification” as the default heading on the outcome card, while retaining the canonical Verification tab/route. Keep the exact VERIFIED state in details and preserve the contract’s interim guardrail-failure wording.

+# W1-UX-05 — Foundation, Readiness, SLD, Health and battery presentation
